reader_summary.overview: A week before the 2020 US Presidential election. While it's easy to forget now, a very viable alternate history exists where it's Twitter, not Facebook, who owns Instagram, and Vine, not TikTok. We dive into it all on this episode — and of course while we had Dick, we also had to discuss his controversial recent deleted tweet.
